api/src/services/audit_context.py.name: Who made the change
api/src/services/audit_context.py.description: Remembers which person or process started each operation so the activity log can name them.

api/src/services/audit_retention/__init_.name: Activity archive policy
api/src/services/audit_retention/__init_.description: Groups the rules that move old activity records into long-term storage and eventually delete them.

api/src/services/audit_retention/archive.name: Archiving old activity
api/src/services/audit_retention/archive.description: Moves activity records past the retention limit into long-term storage, checking each stored copy before removing it.

api/src/services/audit_retention/export..name: Download activity history
api/src/services/audit_retention/export..description: Packs archived and current activity records into one downloadable file for an audit or a handover.

api/src/services/audit_retention/format..name: Archive file format
api/src/services/audit_retention/format..description: Defines the standard file layout for archived activity so a stored copy can be proved intact later.

api/src/services/audit_retention/setting.name: Activity retention settings
api/src/services/audit_retention/setting.description: Stores the platform-wide choice of how long activity history is kept before it is archived.

api/src/services/audit_retention/store.p.name: Archive file storage
api/src/services/audit_retention/store.p.description: Keeps archived activity files in cloud file storage and says so clearly when no storage is available.

api/src/services/audit.py.name: Activity logging
api/src/services/audit.py.description: Records each change in the activity log with who made it, including refused access to files and tables.

api/src/services/conversation_messages.p.name: Chat message order
api/src/services/conversation_messages.p.description: Adds each new message to a conversation in the right order so chats read back correctly.

api/src/services/cron_parser.py.name: Schedule expressions
api/src/services/cron_parser.py.description: Checks a timetable expression, explains it in plain words and works out when a job will next run.

api/src/services/dependency_graph.py.name: What depends on what
api/src/services/dependency_graph.py.description: Maps which workflows, tables, forms and apps rely on each other so you can see what a change will touch.

api/src/services/kubernetes_control.py.name: Cluster upkeep loops
api/src/services/kubernetes_control.py.description: Starts the automatic upkeep tasks only in the parts of the system allowed to run them.

api/src/services/kubernetes_execution.py.name: Task sizing settings
api/src/services/kubernetes_execution.py.description: Holds the settings that decide how much memory each background task gets and whether it runs on its own.

api/src/services/legacy_broker_drain.py.name: Upgrade work recovery
api/src/services/legacy_broker_drain.py.description: Recovers work an older release left waiting so no queued automation run is lost during an upgrade.

api/src/services/notification_access.py.name: Notification privacy
api/src/services/notification_access.py.description: Decides who may read each notification, keeping personal notices private to the person they belong to.

api/src/services/notification_service.py.name: Live notifications
api/src/services/notification_service.py.description: Delivers the alerts and progress messages that appear in the app while someone is using it.

api/src/services/operation_catalog.py.name: Action catalogue
api/src/services/operation_catalog.py.description: Holds the master list of every action the platform offers, keeping the screens, assistant and automations in step.

api/src/services/operation_inventory.py.name: Action coverage check
api/src/services/operation_inventory.py.description: Compares the actions the platform really offers against the master list and reports anything missing or extra.

api/src/services/platform_job_access.py.name: Task visibility rules
api/src/services/platform_job_access.py.description: Controls which background tasks each person can see, hiding other people's work from their list.

api/src/services/platform_job_lease.py.name: One owner per task
api/src/services/platform_job_lease.py.description: Makes sure only one server works on a background task at a time so nothing is written twice.

api/src/services/platform_job_memory_pro.name: Task memory learning
api/src/services/platform_job_memory_pro.description: Learns from past runs how much memory each kind of task needs so the next one starts with enough.

api/src/services/platform_jobs.py.name: Background tasks
api/src/services/platform_jobs.py.description: Runs long jobs such as deploys and exports in the background, showing progress and avoiding duplicates.

api/src/services/product_updates.py.name: Product updates
api/src/services/product_updates.py.description: Shows the release notes built into this version and records which ones each admin has already seen.

api/src/services/roi_settings_service.py.name: Savings units
api/src/services/roi_settings_service.py.description: Stores the units used when showing the time and money automations save, such as minutes and dollars.

api/src/services/run_retention/__init__..name: Run history policy
api/src/services/run_retention/__init__..description: Groups the rules that remove old automation runs and their events once they age out.

api/src/services/run_retention/deleter.p.name: Run history cleanup
api/src/services/run_retention/deleter.p.description: Deletes finished automation runs and their events past the retention limit while keeping the summary totals.

api/src/services/run_retention/settings..name: History retention settings
api/src/services/run_retention/settings..description: Stores how long finished runs and their events are kept before they are deleted.

api/src/services/run_retention/source.py.name: Run history totals
api/src/services/run_retention/source.py.description: Gives one reliable count of runs, combining runs still kept with rolled-up daily totals.

api/src/services/scheduler_diagnostics.p.name: Scheduler health
api/src/services/scheduler_diagnostics.p.description: Records which scheduling servers are alive and keeps a short log so timetable problems can be traced.

api/src/services/service_log_flush.py.name: Log storage
api/src/services/service_log_flush.py.description: Saves the trailing log lines from running automations and trims old ones so logs stay small.

api/src/services/service_memory.py.name: Live memory usage
api/src/services/service_memory.py.description: Reports how much memory each running task is using right now across all the servers.

api/src/services/work_dispatch.py.name: Work hand-off
api/src/services/work_dispatch.py.description: Hands queued work to available servers once the change is safely saved, and picks up anything abandoned.

api/src/services/workflow_keys.py.name: Workflow access keys
api/src/services/workflow_keys.py.description: Creates the secure keys that let an outside system call a workflow without a person signing in.

api/src/services/workflow_orphan.py.name: Missing workflow repair
api/src/services/workflow_orphan.py.description: Finds workflows whose code has disappeared and helps replace, rebuild or switch them off.

api/src/services/workflow_permissions.py.name: Workflow permissions
api/src/services/workflow_permissions.py.description: Decides which powers each workflow runs with and records the approvals a Solution asks for.

api/src/services/workflow_role_service.p.name: Workflow role sharing
api/src/services/workflow_role_service.p.description: Copies a form, app or agent's audience onto the workflows it uses so access stays consistent.

api/src/services/workflow_validation.py.name: Workflow checks
api/src/services/workflow_validation.py.description: Tests workflow code before it goes live so syntax and input mistakes are caught early.
